name: Superb Metals
old_description: We deliver high-performance standing seam metal roofing and commercial building envelope solutions engineered for durability and architectural excellence.
about:
Superb Metals was founded in 1986 in Minneola, Florida, as a supplier of architectural sheet metal for roofing and building envelope applications.

The company custom fabricates standing seam metal roof systems to project specifications and produces custom flashing components such as chimney caps, radius coping, window pans, and Z flashing. It also operates a wholesale division supplying drip edge, butyl tape, RoofIvent Roto vents, Ecos, and other standing seam roofing accessories. A proprietary mechanically seamed system, branded the Guardian System, is engineered to meet Florida’s Miami-Dade building code for extreme wind resistance.

Superb Metals serves roofing contractors and homeowners across central Florida, with project examples including high-end residential roofs in Tavares and commercial building envelopes. Its customer base spans both new construction and renovation projects requiring durable, energy-efficient metal roofing and flashing solutions.

The company’s stated mission emphasizes fast turnaround, personalized consultation drawn from over 40 years of industry experience, fair pricing, and responsive customer service. Its Guardian System is marketed as a storm-rated solution capable of withstanding winds over 325 mph, positioning the firm as a specialist in code-compliant, high-performance metal roofing.
